name: Penne Pasta with Tuna & Tomato Sauce
ingredients: 2 (6 oz) cans chunk light tuna in water
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain.
Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Coat bottom of pan with oil. Add onion and, stirring frequently, cook until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and pepper; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until sauce begins to thicken, 5-6 minutes.
Drain tuna and stir into the sauce. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add pasta and toss to coat.
To serve, place pasta in a bowl. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
